meshes.title: ADVENTURE Pantheon 3D architectural engineering model (linear tetrahedra)
meshes.notes: Authentic Pantheon engineering tetrahedral mesh published by University of Tokyo ADVENTURE. The provider explicitly permits free use of sample data. Source archive is read at test time and converted to native Gmsh 2.2 binary, without committing original or converted files. Content-pinned by SHA-256; upstream does not publish a versioned URL.

meshes.title: MFEM induction heating model
meshes.notes: 30,431-cell first-order tetrahedral engineering geometry. Import, affine patch, and conservation were verified in GitHub Actions. Redistribution terms remain unverified upstream.

meshes.title: Gmsh binary mechanical bracket (235,014 tetrahedral cells)
meshes.notes: Binary Gmsh engineering bracket downloaded through pinned Git LFS with SHA-256 verification. The existing CI workflow converts it to Gmsh 2.2 ASCII with test-only meshio 5.3.5; source physical tags are absent and thus cannot be checked. Affine patch, thermal solve and VTU round-trip were verified.
